verdict.rationale: RunAnywhere is an on-device and hosted model inference SDK and runtime, so serving LoRA adapters on a base model is a fair question for it. However, nothing in the evidence pack mentions LoRA adapters, adapter hot-swapping, or multi-adapter serving. The docs cover generation, streaming, tool calling, model downloads, NPU acceleration and an OpenAI-compatible cloud endpoint, but none of these address the story.
